description: This file defines the DateTime class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling date and time formatting using various format blocks and separators.

classes.name: DateTime
classes.description: Represents a formatter for date and time formats, allowing composition of formats using blocks and separators.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new DateTime object with specified separators and format blocks.

methods.name: mapFormatBlocks
methods.description: Maps each format block to a string, wrapping literals and handling objects appropriately.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Generates and returns the composed date-time format string by joining format blocks with separators.
